literal_source_claim_en: Stability of the number of zeros of functions.

domain_and_universes: Prospective functions from a source-selected subset of Complex to Complex, a disk/Jordan domain/contour and its boundary and interior, and a finite multiplicity-weighted zero count. Exact universes, set or curve encodings, orientation, topology, and regularity remain open.
conclusion: Prospective family only: a dominant holomorphic function and a sufficiently smaller boundary perturbation have the same number of enclosed zeros, counted with multiplicity. The compared functions, domain, count, and exact equality are not canonical fields at intake.
candidate_statement_shapes_not_credited: If f and h are holomorphic on a neighborhood of an enclosed compact region and norm (h z) < norm (f z) on its boundary, then f and f + h have the same number of interior zeros counted with multiplicity.

If f and g are holomorphic on a neighborhood of an enclosed compact region and norm (f z - g z) < norm (f z) on its boundary, then f and g have the same number of interior zeros counted with multiplicity.
